settings.createModeHint: Ticket settings are saved when you click “Create event”
settings.autoSaveHint: Changes on this page are saved automatically
settings.readOnly: Read-only while viewing as another user — ticket settings can't be changed
settings.amountCalcWithGroups: Ticket groups are on, so the total is calculated automatically from the selected tickets.
settings.manualAmount: Let registrants enter the amount themselves (turn off auto total)

tiers.title: Price tiers
tiers.emptyHint: Currently one price for the whole sale (no tiers). For early-bird pricing, set up tiers and give each ticket a price per tier — prices switch automatically on schedule.
tiers.seedDefaults: Set up Early bird / Door prices
tiers.hint: Tiers run one after another and prices switch automatically. The last tier has no end date and applies until the event ends.
tiers.switchToEventEnd: Run until the event ends instead
tiers.warnMissingDeadline: No end date — this tier stays active forever and later tiers will never apply
tiers.missingPrices: {count, plural, one {# ticket has} other {# tickets have}} no “{tier}” price yet and will be charged the base price:

groups.title: Tickets
groups.enableHint: Want to split tickets into groups? E.g. registrants must pick one “Main ticket” and can add any number of “Add-ons”. Common for weekend workshops and festivals.
groups.deleteConfirm:
Delete the group “{title}”?
Its tickets will be left without a group, and any related exclusion rules will be removed too.
groups.requiredConflict: This group is required but has an exclusion rule with “{titles}” — a registrant who picks from there gets blocked, so that group can never be chosen. Make this group optional, or remove the exclusion rule.
groups.emptyGroup: No tickets in this group yet.
groups.ungroupedHint: These tickets won't appear on the registration form. Move them into a group first.

coupons.title: Coupon codes (optional)
coupons.description: The amount adjusts automatically when a registrant enters a coupon code. A fixed amount is taken off once per registration; for a percentage, enter the percent off (e.g. 20 = charge 20% less). Leave the usage limit blank for unlimited uses.
coupons.unsupported: Coupon codes only work for events with automatic totals (using ticket groups, or with “Let registrants enter the amount” turned off).
coupons.usedCount: Used {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}

flag.title: Attendee checkbox (optional)
flag.description: When filled in, every attendee on the registration form gets an extra checkbox, e.g. “Joining the runway contest”. When editing a ticket you can require a minimum number of attendees to tick it. Leave blank to hide it.

exclusions.title: Exclusion rules (optional)
exclusions.description: Once set, as soon as a registrant picks a ticket in one group, the other group locks and shows “Included in…”. Typical use: a Full Pass already includes the single classes, so nobody buys them twice.

preview.title: Live registration page preview
preview.description: This is the ticket picker registrants will see. Try clicking around.
preview.autoTotal: Total (calculated automatically, {count, plural, one {# attendee} other {# attendees}})
preview.empty: Once you add tickets, a live preview of the registration page appears here.

drawer.noTierOnSale: At least one tier must sell this ticket
drawer.invalidAmount: Please enter a valid amount (a whole number, 0 or more)
drawer.invalidSeatCount: People per ticket must be a whole number from 1 to 10
drawer.invalidMinFlagged: The minimum number of ticked attendees must be a whole number from 0 to {max}
drawer.seatCountLocked: People have already registered with this ticket, so the number of people can't be changed. For a different number, hide this ticket and create a new one.
drawer.seatCountBundle: Bundle: the price below is for the whole group of {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} and isn't multiplied again; registrants must enter exactly {count, plural, one {# attendee} other {# attendees}}.
drawer.seatCountHint: Enter 1 for a regular ticket (price × number of attendees). For bundles such as a couple ticket, enter 2 or more; the price is then for the whole group.
drawer.descriptionPlaceholderBundle: e.g. For 2 people; 1 of them must join the runway contest
drawer.descriptionHint: Shown below the ticket name on the registration form.
drawer.minFlaggedHint: 0 = not required. E.g. if one person in a 1+1 bundle must compete, enter 1 — the registration can't be submitted until it's ticked.
drawer.minFlaggedInactive: This event has no attendee checkbox set up, so this requirement has no effect; you can change it to 0.
drawer.priceLabelBundle: Price (for {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}) *
drawer.fillRest: Use the same price for the other tiers
drawer.tiersHint: This event has {count, plural, one {# price tier} other {# price tiers}}. For a ticket sold only in some tiers (e.g. early bird only), untick “On sale” for the other tiers and the registration page will show “Sales closed”.
drawer.noTierOnSaleHint: At least one tier must sell this ticket.
drawer.baseLast: “{tier}” is the last tier and sets this ticket's base price.
drawer.baseEarly: “{tier}” is the last tier this ticket is sold in and sets its base price; in later tiers the registration page shows “Sales closed” and no “You save” amount.
drawer.amountLabelBundle: Amount (for {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}) *
